en: A black and white vintage image showing a lively beach scene with children playing in the sand and women in period dress supervising. In the background there are distinctive beach wicker chairs and a large ornate building on stilts with multiple towers and domes extending over the water, resembling a bathhouse or pier building typical of late 19th or early 20th-century seaside resorts.
